hook_line: INDIA A BOWL NEPAL OUT FOR 26 IN 306-RUN RISING STARS WIN

hook_stat.sub: Nepal all out for 26 in 11.3 overs — the fifth-lowest total in List A history

stats.label: India A's margin of victory in runs in Doha
Runs by Kumar Kushagra, off 102 balls
Bowling figures for Prince Yadav, from five overs

diaspora_bullets: Kumar Kushagra was named player of the match
Next up in Doha on Sunday: Pakistan Shaheens
news_summary: India A beat Nepal by 306 runs in Doha: 332 for 9 against 26 all out in 11.3 overs, in the ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars.
payoff: The win gives India A two points and a commanding net-run-rate start in Group B.
